Rhode Island has enacted 4 AI-related laws. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Rhode Island

4 laws this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S2195: Creates additional safety features for AI companion technology that include addressing suicidal ideation, potential physical harm or financial harm to others expressed by a user. It also requires notification the AI companion does not have human emotions. passed 2026-06-22

    This chapter regulates AI companion models in Rhode Island. It requires operators to include safety protocols for suicidal ideation, self-harm, and physical harm to others, and to notify users that they are not communicating with a human. It also requires annual reporting to the attorney general and authorizes civil penalties.

  • S2570: Requires healthcare providers and healthcare facilities to inform patients of the use of artificial intelligence to memorialize patient visits. passed 2026-06-22

    This law requires healthcare providers and healthcare facilities that use artificial intelligence to document in person or telehealth visits to notify patients of that use. It also requires those providers and facilities to review the documentation generated by AI for accuracy after the visit. The purpose is to ensure patients are properly notified of AI use by healthcare providers.

  • H7538: Requires healthcare providers and healthcare facilities to inform patients of the use of artificial intelligence to memorialize patient visits. passed 2026-06-22

    This law requires healthcare providers and healthcare facilities to tell patients when artificial intelligence is used to document in person or telehealth visits. It also requires those providers and facilities to review the AI generated documentation for accuracy after the visit.

  • H7350: Creates additional safety features for AI companion technology that include addressing suicidal ideation, potential physical harm or financial harm to others expressed by a user. It also requires notification the AI companion does not have human emotions. passed 2026-06-22

    This act creates safety requirements for AI companion technology. It requires operators to include protocols for addressing suicidal ideation, self-harm, and physical harm to others expressed by users, and to refer users to crisis services when such expressions are detected. It also requires notification that the user is not communicating with a human, annual reporting to the attorney general, and authorizes civil penalties for violations.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Rhode Island. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
